test: Blind API-only file context, trial 2, preloaded contract
scoring: Freeze these source-based criteria before the subagent receives its task; 1 point complete, 0.5 materially correct but incomplete, 0 absent/wrong. No score for speculation. Related-file facts are separately labeled.
limitations: Checklist coverage is not overall accuracy. The report also contains one verified incorrect inference about a supporting helper, outside these frozen criteria. No criteria were added or changed after the report.

criteria.expected: Application WorkspaceService implements allowlisted filesystem browsing plus registration orchestration; state group *Workspaces, defaults ManagerConfig, roots []domain.FolderRoot.
criteria.assessment: Purpose, state, application boundaries and full declaration inventory recovered.

criteria.expected: Identify and explain all 10 named functions/methods: NewWorkspaceService, FolderRoots, root, validFolderPath, Folders, readFolderPage, skipFolderEntries, AddWorkspace, gitRegistrationError, selectedPath. Anonymous deferred closure is distinct, not a second named method.
criteria.assessment: All 10 named functions/methods explained; 15 declarations cataloged including the separate deferred closure.

criteria.expected: Canonicalize configured paths, verify os.OpenRoot access then close; IDs lowercase SHA256 of canonical root, basename display name and canonical path; errors abort constructor. canonicalWorkspacePath uses Abs/EvalSymlinks in workspaces.go.
criteria.assessment: Canonicalization, access check and handle closure, SHA256 identity, basename/path, and errors recovered.

criteria.expected: FolderRoots returns a defensive slice copy; root does exact ID lookup and otherwise ErrFolderForbidden.
criteria.assessment: Defensive slice copy, ignored context, exact root lookup and forbidden error recovered.

criteria.expected: Nonempty, <=4096 bytes, no NUL, filepath.IsLocal; '.' is allowed, not a general ban on all internal '..' segments or all symlinks.
criteria.assessment: Nonempty/4096-byte/NUL/IsLocal policy and dot selection recovered without inventing a literal ban on every parent segment or all symlinks.

criteria.expected: Folders accepts context, root ID, relative path, offset and returns FolderPage/error; reject offsets <0 or >100000 and invalid path before lookup.
criteria.assessment: Arguments, return shape, offset range and validation-before-lookup ordering recovered.

criteria.expected: Folders opens an os.Root, then root-relative file handle, closes both with defers. Open failures mapped to ErrFolderForbidden. Root confinement includes symlink components.
criteria.assessment: Root-relative handles, deferred closes, symlink-component confinement and sanitized open errors recovered.

criteria.expected: Page path cleaned and slash-normalized; initializes nonnil items; skip offset raw entries and ReadDir(100) in native order, not 100 visible folders.
criteria.assessment: Normalization, nonnil items, raw-entry skipping/page size and unsorted live reads recovered.

criteria.expected: Returns directories except .git; regular files excluded, symlink entries not followed/listed as directories. Other dot-directories are not universally hidden.
criteria.assessment: Correct IsDir-and-not-.git predicate, but does not explicitly recover that directory symlink entries are omitted. This is a partial omission, not a claim that they are followed.

criteria.expected: Only len(raw entries)==100 sets next_offset=offset+100; an empty visible page can still have a next page, exact multiple can require an extra empty page.
criteria.assessment: Raw-count continuation, potentially empty visible pages and exact-multiple extra page recovered; also notes maximum-offset continuation defect.

criteria.expected: Skips entries with min(offset,100), checks cancellation between chunks, EOF is normal, other read errors become ErrFolderForbidden; no unbounded allocation.
criteria.assessment: Bounded reads, cancellation between skipping chunks, EOF and sanitized other errors recovered.

criteria.expected: ReadDir EOF tolerated, non-EOF error sanitized, final page returns ctx.Err (may include constructed items and cancellation). This is not a directory snapshot/stable cursor.
criteria.assessment: Final page plus context error, EOF tolerance, sanitized failures and absence of stable directory snapshot recovered.

criteria.expected: selectedPath checks relative folder plus name <=200 bytes/no NUL, allowed root lookup. Raw name length tested before TrimSpace.
criteria.assessment: Relative-path and name byte/NUL constraints, allowed-root lookup and name checking before trimming recovered.

criteria.expected: Join root and requested path, EvalSymlinks, filepath.Rel and IsLocal reject escapes; failures sanitized. This path check is distinct from os.Root used in browsing, not a proof against every filesystem race.
criteria.assessment: Join/EvalSymlinks/Rel/IsLocal validation distinguished from os.Root and not claimed to eliminate all filesystem races.

criteria.expected: AddWorkspace calls source.Open with default Options before group.Add. Dependency requires exact working-tree root; no git init/clone/fetch is performed.
criteria.assessment: Default Git options before group.Add and exact working-tree-root validation recovered; no initialization claimed.

criteria.expected: Copy defaults and override RepositoryPath and trimmed RepositoryName; invoke group.Add, propagate error; preserve other manager settings.
criteria.assessment: Copied defaults, path override, name trimming, preserved poll/timeout settings and delegated errors recovered.

criteria.expected: Return manager.Repository plus AlreadyAdded=reused; gitRegistrationError preserves context cancellation/deadline, otherwise ErrNotGitRepository (doesn't expose raw git error).
criteria.assessment: Repository/AlreadyAdded reuse and cancellation-preserving sanitized Git failure recovered.

criteria.expected: workspace.add span; execution.started; deferred completion or telemetry.Fail(workspace_registration_failed) based on named error; span.End. Direct source/name not emitted as trace attributes here.
criteria.assessment: Span name, started/completed/failure events, named-error deferred handling and end order recovered without claiming source/name trace attributes.

criteria.expected: No direct SQL/LLM/index parsing in this file. Workspace persistence/tracker behavior delegated to group.Add; registration succeeds before background indexing completes.
criteria.assessment: Application delegation to persistence and manager lifecycle recovered; registration is not completion of background indexing.

criteria.expected: Workspaces.Add locks, handles closed, duplicate path idempotently, enforces32, requires WorkspaceStore, creates manager and persists before appending/starting; first manager becomes default; failed persistence closes it.
criteria.assessment: Locking, closed/duplicate/capacity/store checks, persist-before-publication/start, default selection and failure cleanup recovered.

criteria.expected: persistAddedWorkspace revalidates actual Git root and delegates durable registration with operator workspace.add execution; avoid claiming target file itself owns transaction or persistence internals.
criteria.assessment: Actual-root revalidation and operator/workspace.add persistence execution recovered; SQL transaction internals explicitly left unverified.

criteria.expected: managedExplorerServer constructs service and passes as WorkspaceManagement; HTTP roots/folders/add call it through interface (static call resolution may not prove concrete target); domain FolderRoot,FolderPage,AddWorkspaceRequest,AddedWorkspace shapes.
criteria.assessment: DTOs, interface, construction/injection and inferred HTTP dispatch recovered; empty incoming call pages not equated with unused code.

criteria.expected: Related transport: authenticated root/folder/add endpoints; foreign-origin registration rejected; add 201 new/200 duplicate, folder forbidden403, nonGit422,limit409; not logic directly owned by target.
criteria.assessment: Authentication, origin rejection and 201/200/403/422/409 mappings recovered as transport behavior. Separate Content-Type error is recorded below, outside this criterion.

criteria.expected: Existing tests cover escapes/symlink/missing/nonGit(no initialization),105dir pagination/.git hiding,bad offset/unknown root/cancellation,unconfigured manager persistence. If unavailable from API, state unavailable rather than claim executed tests.
criteria.assessment: All required target unit-test evidence recovered without claiming execution. The additional incorrect claim about a related HTTP test is recorded separately below.

unscored_findings.claim: An absent Content-Type is rejected before decoding, so the invalid-body cases can pass only by hitting that guard.
unscored_findings.correction: jsonContentType explicitly returns true for an empty header. The alleged early-rejection explanation is false; the body decoder is reached.
unscored_findings.availability: Complete helper implementation is available from the same pinned symbol API; no request for it appears in the independent agent ledger.
unscored_findings.scope: One underlying wrong assumption appears both in the transport summary and in the test-quality criticism. First report preserved unchanged; no corrected agent retry.
